novelty_basis: The statement is Theorem 1.4 of Cusenza et al., Fib. Quart. 60 (2022), arXiv:2009.09510; the proof via lazy representations is new to us and much shorter.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C19.md Corollary 3, from CLM-C19-02 - a split-only game ends at the lazy representation, which equals the Zeckendorf representation exactly for alternating digit strings); consistent with EXP-C19-01 (bound attained exactly at F_k - 1 for n <= 150)
statement: The Zeckendorf game on n can be played with split and combine-1 moves only iff n = F_k - 1 for some k >= 2.
title: A short proof that only n = F_k - 1 can be played with split moves alone (Cusenza et al., Thm 1.4)
